base_rationale: git status --porcelain non-empty -> working-tree dogfood -> base = HEAD (deterministic state test, Step 1.1)
style_gates_rationale: no shared style config in `inside`, so an outside style result cannot flip; absent from BOTH maps

scope_check.disposition: RECORDED, then disproven per class — never waived (L17). The base is the last COMMIT, so `scope` sees this increment's changes PLUS the previous increment's, which are uncommitted in the same working tree; `--feature plan-cue-continuation` exempts only THIS feature's artifacts. Four classes, none a breach: (1) the two hook scripts, both human-applied (fix #2 denies Write/Edit/MultiEdit to the agent on each); (2) .dev/features/out-of-root-deny-message/** — the previous increment's artifacts, each written by its own stage under that stage's own Step-0 scope and declared in ITS plan; (3) .dev/memory-bank/lessons-learned.md — the two gated promotions, check-provenance GREEN with the scope pinned to that one file; (4) docs/lessons-index.md — the derived index regenerated by `npm run docs:generate`, a declared Bash write (L19). NAMED LIMITATION: stacking two increments in one uncommitted working tree makes this partition structurally noisy, because `scope` asks changed-since-base and the base cannot be 'after increment 1' until increment 1 is committed.
